entities.name: RibBA (query sequence)
observations: 414-aa query sequence strongly matches reviewed bacterial RibBA proteins (71–74% identity; approximately 95% query coverage).
Homology-supported bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis enzyme with EC 3.5.4.25 (GTP cyclohydrolase II) and EC 4.1.99.12 (3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate synthase).

Reference annotations report conversion of D-ribulose 5-phosphate to 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate plus formate; and conversion of GTP to a ribosylaminopyrimidine intermediate, formate, and pyrophosphate. Reference assignments are homology evidence, not direct assay of query sequence.
